spans.s:
After a verb ending in the affix णि (causal) the आत्मनेपद is used, provided that when the object in the non-णि or non-causal sense becomes the agent in the causal; and when it does not mean 'to remember with regret', even when the fruit of the action does not accrue to the agent.

Terms: आत्मनेपद

The इ of the verbal अङ्ग (stem) formed with the affix णि is elided before an आर्धधातुक affix which does not take the augment इट् ।

Terms: आर्धधातुक changes

The word वृत्त is formed from the causative of वृत् in the sense of 'studied through or read'.

Terms: इट् augment

The न of कृत् affix ordained after a causative verb (णयन्त), is optionally changed into ण , when it comes after an उपसर्ग having a cause of change.

Terms: सन्धि-हल्-कृत्-उपसर्ग
